title: Bound on recursive pair decomposition
statement: Starting from a bit string $w$, form a list recursively: use the empty list when $w$ is empty; otherwise prepend the first component obtained by parsing $w$ (using the empty string if parsing fails) and continue with its parsed second component (again using the empty string if parsing fails). The resulting list has length at most the length of $w$.
